what: The plan adds tally SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE output but does not update the downstream KV chain that must read and forward it
scenario_or_breakage: Normal Step 3 captures tally output inside plan-review-loop, which currently parses only TALLY_PLAN_REVIEW_STATUS and VOTING_TALLY_FILE; run-step3-review and the SKILL Step 3 handoff also allowlist fixed key sets. The MainAgent re-tally prose can reference SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE, but the variable may never reach that orchestrator state.
suggested_fix: Add the minimum passthrough: have plan-review-loop pass the flag to tally when set, parse SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE, include it in emit_loop_kvs and write_step3_result_env, then add it to run-step3-review parse/emit/result-env allowlists and the SKILL Step 3 handoff allowlist.
